for d in 1 2 3 4; do BACKUP_STAMP=2026010$d-000000 bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name app "$t/src" >/dev/null; done

echo "--- verify with name filter:"; bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name app; echo "rc=$?"

echo "--- unknown option exits 1:"; bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name app --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
